summary: Use a Chip Select to show one filter, such as a date range, and whether it is applied.

useWhen.text: Show one filter, such as a date range, and whether it is applied.

from.quote: Use a Chip Select to show one filter, such as a date range, and whether it is applied.

avoidWhen.text: A filter that does not apply: hide it instead. Chip Select has no disabled state.

from.quote: There is no disabled state; hide a filter that does not apply instead.

anatomy.holds: Hints at the kind of filter, such as a date.

from.quote: Hints at the kind of filter, such as a date.

anatomy.holds: Names the filter, or the value once applied.

from.quote: Names the filter, or the value once applied.

anatomy.holds: Shown when Active; shows that pressing again clears the filter.

from.quote: Shows that pressing again clears the filter.

anatomy.holds: Fully rounded shape that turns lavender when Active.

from.quote: Fully rounded shape that turns lavender when Active.

placementAdvice.text: In the guide's In context, the filters sit above the list they filter, a transaction list.

from.quote: Filters above a transaction list
Height is fixed at 32 px.

placementAdvice.text: Width grows with the label and the icons, so short labels keep a row of chips on one line.

from.quote: Width grows with the label and the icons, so short labels keep a row of chips on one line.

configuration.text: Idle names the filter; Active shows the chosen value and how to clear it.

from.quote: Idle names the filter; Active shows the chosen value and how to clear it.

configuration.text: One property, active, switches the chip between Idle and Active.

from.quote: One property switches the chip between Idle and Active.

configuration.text: Figma's State variant maps to the active property, which sets the ChipSelect State mode.

from.quote: Figma’s State variant maps to the active property, which sets the ChipSelect State mode.

configuration.text: With active unset (false), the chip is Idle.

from.quote: The screen owns each filter.

configuration.text: In the guide's In context, pressing an Idle chip opens a picker (not part of Chip Select) and pressing an Active chip clears it; the screen owns what a press does.

from.quote: Pressing an Idle chip opens a picker (not part of Chip Select); pressing an Active chip clears it.

configuration.text: The screen updates the chip's state (active) and label after each choice.

from.quote: The screen updates the chip’s state and label after each choice.

configuration.text: The whole chip is one press target: the close icon is part of it, not a separate button.

from.quote: The close icon is part of the single press target, not a separate button.

configuration.text: Choose an icon that matches the filter.

from.quote: Choose an icon that matches the filter

configuration.text: Calendar icon, the default: for date and period filters.

from.quote: The default, for date and period filters.

configuration.text: icon is ic_calendar_week, the calendar icon, by default.
Filter icon (ic_filter in the guide's code): for other attribute filters.

from.quote: For other attribute filters.

configuration.text: Match the icon to the filter: a calendar signals a date filter.

from.quote: A calendar signals a date filter.

configuration.text: Don't use an unrelated icon: a home icon on a date filter confuses the meaning.

from.quote: A home icon on a date filter confuses the meaning.

configuration.text: The leading icon shows in both states, as in Figma.

from.quote: The leading icon shows in both states, as in Figma.

configuration.text: Keep the close icon whenever a press clears the filter: the × tells people a press removes the filter.

from.quote: keep the close icon whenever a press clears the filter

configuration.text: Hide the close icon (showCloseIcon false) only when a press reopens the picker instead of clearing.

from.quote: Only when a press reopens the picker instead of clearing.

configuration.text: Don't hide the close icon when a press clears: without the ×, people cannot tell how to undo the filter.

from.quote: Without the ×, people cannot tell how to undo the filter.

configuration.text: showCloseIcon is true by default, and the close icon shows only when the chip is Active.

rules.text: While Idle, use one or two words for the filter.

from.quote: While Idle, use one or two words for the filter.

rules.text: Once applied, replace them with the chosen value so the row reads as a summary.

from.quote: Once applied, replace them with the chosen value so the row reads as a summary.

rules.text: Show the chosen value: “Last 30 days” tells people what the list is showing.

from.quote: “Last 30 days” tells people what the list is showing.

rules.text: Don't keep the generic label once the filter applies: an Active “Date” chip does not say which dates.

from.quote: An Active “Date” chip does not say which dates.

states.when: active false (the default): grey background, dark text; the label names the filter.

from.quote: Grey background, dark text.

states.when: active true: lavender background, purple icon, text, and close icon; the label shows the chosen value.

from.quote: Lavender background, purple icon, text, and close icon.

accessibility.text: On the web the chip is a button named by its label and announced as pressed when Active; Enter and click activate it.

from.quote: On the web the chip is a button named by its label and announced as pressed when Active; Enter and click activate it.

accessibility.text: Developers can replace the name with accessibilityLabel.

from.quote: Developers can replace the name with accessibilityLabel.

accessibility.text: accessibilityLabel is the chip's accessible name; without it, the name is the visible label.

examples.purpose: Filters above a transaction list, the guide's In context, once the screen has applied the date filter: the date chip is Active and shows its value, “Last 30 days”, with the close icon (a press clears it); Category is Idle (a press opens the screen's picker, which is not part of Chip Select). The row is a ChipGroup, the pack's component for a row of Chip Select filters (the guide's own code lays the two chips out in a plain wrapping row), named “Transaction filters” as the ChipGroup entry advises. The literal values and empty onPress stand for the screen's own state and picker.
examples.jsx:
<ChipGroup accessibilityLabel="Transaction filters">
  <ChipSelect label="Last 30 days" icon="ic_calendar_week" active onPress={() => {}} />
  <ChipSelect label="Category" icon="ic_filter" active={false} onPress={() => {}} />
</ChipGroup>

from.quote: Pressing an Idle chip opens a picker (not part of Chip Select); pressing an Active chip clears it.

examples.purpose: An applied date filter whose press reopens the picker instead of clearing it, the guide's Active without close icon: the only case for hiding the close icon. onPress stands for the screen reopening its picker.

from.quote: Only when a press reopens the picker instead of clearing.

examples.purpose: One filter on its own, Idle: “Category” names an attribute filter, with the filter icon, as the guide's Configuration and Content show it. A press opens the screen's picker; once a value is chosen, the screen sets active and replaces the label with the value (Content's applied labels, such as “Groceries”).

from.quote: For other attribute filters.

props.name: label
props.description: Label text to display. Default "Date", from the component source.

props.name: active
props.description: On the web, aria-pressed follows active. Declared: Whether the chip is in active state. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: icon
props.description: The leading icon shows in both states, as in Figma. Declared: Icon name to display in Idle state (when active is false). Default "ic_calendar_week", from the component source.

props.name: showCloseIcon
props.description: Whether to show the close icon when active. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: labelSlot
props.description: Optional slot to override the label text.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: On the web the chip's aria-label comes from label; accessibilityLabel replaces that name. Declared: Accessible name. Defaults to the visible `label`.

props.name: accessibilityHint
props.description: Additional accessibility hint for screen readers.

props.name: testID
props.description: Test identifier for E2E / unit tests.

modes.name: ChipSelect State
modes.description: active forces this mode (Idle or Active); a ChipSelect State passed in modes is overridden. Declared: A token collection ChipSelect reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Color Mode
modes.description: A token collection ChipSelect reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

slots.name: labelSlot
slots.description: Optional slot to override the label text.
